title: Bear and Bowling
statementMd:
Limak is an old brown bear. He often goes bowling with his friends. Today he feels really good and tries to beat his own record!

For rolling a ball one gets a score — an integer (maybe negative) number of points. Score for $*i*$-th roll is multiplied by $*i*$ and scores are summed up. So, for $*k*$ rolls with scores $*s*_{1}, *s*_{2}, ..., *s*_{*k*}$, total score is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c8a1cac733e2c38459a7a155ea158ee99d347e49.png). Total score is $0$ if there were no rolls.

Limak made $*n*$ rolls and got score $*a*_{*i*}$ for $*i*$-th of them. He wants to maximize his total score and he came up with an interesting idea. He will cancel some rolls, saying that something distracted him or there was a strong wind.

Limak is able to cancel any number of rolls, maybe even all or none of them. Total score is calculated as if there were only non-canceled rolls. Look at the sample tests for clarification. What maximum total score can Limak get?

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$).

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($|*a*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{7})$ - scores for Limak's rolls.

## Output

Print the maximum possible total score after choosing rolls to cancel.

## Note

In first sample Limak should cancel rolls with scores $- 8$ and $- 3$. Then he is left with three rolls with scores $- 2, 0, 5$. Total score is $1·( - 2) + 2·0 + 3·5 = 13$.

In second sample Limak should cancel roll with score $- 50$. Total score is $1·( - 10) + 2·20 + 3·( - 30) + 4·40 + 5·60 = 400$.
statementZhMd:
Limak 是一只年迈的棕熊。他经常和朋友们一起打保龄球。今天他感觉非常好，并且想要打破自己的记录！

每次投球都会得到一个分数——一个整数（可能为负数）。第 $*i*$ 次投球的分数会乘以 $*i*$，然后将所有分数相加。因此，对于分数为 $*s*_{1}, *s*_{2}, ..., *s*_{*k*}$ 的 $*k*$ 次投球，总得分为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c8a1cac733e2c38459a7a155ea158ee99d347e49.png)。如果没有进行投球，总得分为 $0$。

Limak 投了 $*n*$ 次球，第 $*i*$ 次投球得到的分数为 $*a*_{*i}$。他想最大化自己的总得分，于是想出了一个有趣的主意。他可以取消一些投球，理由可以是有什么事情分散了他的注意力，或者当时风很大。

Limak 可以取消任意数量的投球，甚至可以全部取消或一次都不取消。总得分将按照只剩下未取消的投球来计算。请查看样例以进一步了解。Limak 能获得的最大总得分是多少？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$|*a*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{7}$），表示 Limak 每次投球的分数。

## 输出格式

输出选择取消一些投球后可能得到的最大总得分。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Limak 应该取消分数为 $- 8$ 和 $- 3$ 的投球。这样，他剩下三次投球，分数分别为 $- 2, 0, 5$。总得分为 $1·( - 2) + 2·0 + 3·5 = 13$。

在第二个样例中，Limak 应该取消分数为 $- 50$ 的投球。总得分为 $1·( - 10) + 2·20 + 3·( - 30) + 4·40 + 5·60 = 400$。
